mapper.select: SELECT tpl_id AS tplId, change_type AS changeType, change_name AS changeName, change_content as changeContent, DATE_FORMAT( created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS createdTime, created_by AS createdBy FROM ssd_query_template_change_log WHERE tpl_id = #{tplId} ORDER BY created_time DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT DATE_FORMAT( created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS createdTime FROM ssd_query_template_change_log WHERE tpl_id = #{tplId} ORDER BY created_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT tpl_id as tplId, DATE_FORMAT( MAX(created_time), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS createdTime FROM ssd_query_template_change_log WHERE created_time > DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY tpl_id
mapper.insert: insert into ssd_query_template_change_log ( tpl_id, change_type, change_name, change_content, created_time, created_by ) values ( #{tplId}, #{changeType}, #{changeName}, #{changeContent}, now(), #{createdBy} )
